landing.summary: Fifteen years turning ambiguous problems into funded decisions. Built and led teams across three continents. Currently evaluating Chief of Staff and CSO roles at scale-stage companies.

career.intro: One placeholder entry, built to validate the pattern every future role will follow.

context.label: Context
context.body: Company X was a mid-market logistics platform preparing for a Series C round, with three regional business units reporting through inconsistent metrics.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.body: The board could not compare unit performance across regions, which delayed two prior fundraising conversations by a combined four months (placeholder figures).

actions.label: Actions
actions.body: Designed a single reporting framework across the three units, renegotiated two vendor contracts, and rebuilt the planning cycle from annual to rolling quarterly.

impact.label: Impact
impact.body: Reporting cycle time reduced from 21 to 6 days. Series C closed 5 weeks ahead of the revised timeline (placeholder figures).

lessons.label: Lessons
lessons.body: Standardizing metrics before scaling headcount would have avoided a second re-org 18 months later.
